digest.component_or_area: fsck command suite and store layer
propositions: Three pure filesystem primitives (_resolve_tracker_git_dir, _ticket_dirs, _dir_is_archived) currently live in fsck_repair.py but logically belong in gitutil.py as stdlib-only store-layer utilities

Seven production modules reach into fsck_repair.py to import these three primitives, creating an inverted dependency where the command-layer repair module is imported by both command-layer and store-layer consumers

Moving the three primitives to gitutil.py and repointing all seven consumers eliminates the structural inversion while maintaining backward-compatibility re-exports in fsck.py and fsck_repair.py for existing tests
The move preserves gitutil.py as a stdlib-only leaf module (no module-level rebar imports) and keeps _dir_is_archived's reducer import function-local to avoid introducing cycles
Test compatibility surfaces at fsck._resolve_tracker_git_dir, fsck._ticket_dirs, and fsck_repair module attributes must remain resolvable through re-exports without editing any test files
